title_en: Fall 2026 Recruitment of New Students for the AI Semiconductor Interdisciplinary Major
summary: The department is recruiting new students to enter the AI Semiconductor interdisciplinary major (융합전공 인공지능반도체) in Fall 2026. The notice text gives no eligibility rules, deadline, application place or procedure; these may be in the two attached files, which were not read. Students who wish to apply should open the attachments and, if anything is unclear, contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
applies_to: Students who wish to newly enter the AI Semiconductor interdisciplinary major in Fall 2026. Participation is voluntary (this is a recruitment notice). The notice text states no further eligibility limits; the attachments indicate a separate application form for freshmen (신입생) and a separate manual for currently enrolled students (재학생).

dates.what: Semester in which new students enter the AI Semiconductor interdisciplinary major

steps: Open and read the attachments to the notice, which may contain the eligibility rules, deadline and procedure. Their content was not read for this translation.
Freshmen: use Attachment 1, the interdisciplinary major application form for freshmen ([붙임1] 융합전공 신청서(신입생).hwp).
Enrolled students: follow Attachment 2, the interdisciplinary major application and cancellation manual for enrolled students ([붙임2] 융합전공 신청 및 취소 매뉴얼(재학생용).pdf).
If the deadline or submission method is unclear, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Title: Fall 2026 Recruitment of New Students for the AI Semiconductor Interdisciplinary Major (2026년 2학기 융합전공 인공지능반도체 신규진입생 모집 안내)

Posted: 2026-07-23

Attachments (2)
[Attachment 1] Interdisciplinary Major Application Form (Freshmen) (융합전공 신청서(신입생).hwp, 44 KB)
[Attachment 2] Interdisciplinary Major Application and Cancellation Manual (for Enrolled Students) (융합전공 신청 및 취소 매뉴얼(재학생용).pdf, 882 KB)

Note: The notice contains no body text beyond the title and the list of attachments. The content of the attached files was not read and is not included in this translation.
